main_text.p: merito à nostris perstringantur Romanæ Synagogæ Hypocritæ: Continentia tamen ista vitæ sobria, & priscæ frugalitas, quæ ita indulget corpori, ut adsit, quod sustentet illud commodè ad sarcinam suam bajulandam; Ita minuit demensum, ut amputetur, quod luxuriat, atque affigat Humo divinam particulam auræ, ut Poëta modulatur ex Naturæ dictamine[?]. Non à Servatore tantum & Apostolis, severè[?] præcipitur, sed in primæva successorum praxi summo estimatur in pretio. Enimvero qui expectant seriò Domini Adventum, & bonâ fide credunt Mundum hunc tandem consenescere, non possunt sicco pede aut oculo transilire, illud Servatoris de evitandis extremis periculisLuc.21.[?] ñs[?]: Si alij vos negligant, si non retrahant à præcipitijs, extrahant à lustris, avertant à corruptelis, si corruptionibus aut pœnis non cohibeant, aut non deterreant, Tremebunda execrationis religione: Attendite tamen vobismetipsis (vel ob Servatoris concionantis Reverentiam) ne forte graventur corda vestra crapulâ, & ebrietate, & curis huius mundi, & superveniat in vos repentina dies illa. page.notes: Greek characters are printed above "periculis" and could not be read; they are not transcribed. Small illegible marginal marks appear beside the first lines and beside "Mundum" and "corruptelis" on the right; they are not transcribed. The "80" at the lower right corner appears to be a scan or sequence number rather than a printed page number, so it is omitted. The italic/roman distinction is uncertain in several places; italic was assigned from the Scripture quotations and the more slanted type. "leverè" is read as "severè" with [?] because the first letter is unclear. "distamine" is read as "dictamine" with [?] because the letters are blurred. The marginal reference is read as "Luc.21." with [?].
